Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيْ لَاإِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ
Translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah, there is no god but He
The Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Possessor of Majesty and Honor
And I ask Him to accept my repentance
The repentance of a humble, submissive servant
Poor and distressed
Needy, lowly, seeking protection
Who possesses neither benefit nor harm for himself

Arabic text: وَلَا مَوْتًا وَلَا حَيَاةً وَلَا نُشُورًا
Translation: Nor death, nor life, nor resurrection

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ نَفْسٍ لَاتَشْبَعُ
Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from a soul that is never satisfied
And from a heart that does not fear You
And from knowledge that does not benefit
And from a prayer that is not lifted up
And from a supplication that is not heard

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْيُسْرَ بَعْدَ الْعُسْرِ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You for ease after hardship
And relief after distress
And comfort after difficulty

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ مَا بِنَا مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ فَمِنْكَ
Translation: O Allah, whatever blessings we have are from You
There is no god but You
I seek Your forgiveness and I turn to You in repentance
